list_child.name: list_plant_orders
list_child.desc: This tool returns the full list of plant orders currently on file with the garden center. It is helpful whenever you need a complete view of what has been ordered from growers.

get_child.name: get_plant_order
get_child.desc: This tool fetches a single plant order using its unique identifier. Use it when you already know which specific order you want to inspect.

list_parent.name: list_growers
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every grower the garden center currently sources plants from. It gives a full picture of the supplier network in one call.

get_parent.name: get_grower
get_parent.desc: This tool retrieves the details for one grower given its id. It returns the grower's name and contact information.

delete_child.name: delete_plant_order
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently removes a plant order from the system, and the deletion cannot be reversed. It should only be used when an order was entered in error or is no longer relevant.

set_enum.name: set_order_phase
set_enum.desc: This tool advances or reverts a plant order's phase between ordered, shipped, and arrived. It is the main way to track where a shipment stands in the supply chain.

set_bool.name: flag_prepaid
set_bool.desc: This tool marks a plant order as pre-paid, indicating the balance has already been settled. It is typically used once payment has been confirmed with the grower.

set_ref.name: reassign_grower
set_ref.desc: This tool moves a plant order from one grower to another. Use it when an order needs to be resourced or was logged against the wrong supplier.

send.name: email_grower
send.desc: This tool sends an email to a grower regarding a plant order. It is the standard channel for following up on shipment timing or order details.
